name: net.youmi.overseas.android.ui.activity.YoumiTaskDetailActivity
description: When a user selects an offer from the Youmi wall or task records, this screen shows its reward and required steps and lets the user start or continue a step. A successful point claim opens Youmi’s points confirmation.
disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue that Youmi offer task through this screen, but the host app’s other features remain available.
